> This file is autogenerated by 'make'.
> Edits should be made in the files under src/utilities/.

# Utilities

Space-wide views that belong to no other library: a tag cloud, a health
table that counts what needs attention in a space, with a detail page per
check, and change proposals: edits to a page that someone else (typically an
agent without write access to that page) proposes, and that you review as a
diff and apply with one click.

Nothing is stored beyond what you apply: every view is computed from the index
and the pages when it is shown. Pages call `utilities.tagCloud()`,
`utilities.health()` and `utilities.proposals()` only, so a space that
restricts what pages may call needs just these three entries on its allowlist.

## Features

* *Tag cloud* every tag of the space once, alphabetically, as links to its tag
  page.
* *Health table* one row per check with its count and a link to its detail:
  * *MCP scan: findings* and *files that are not pages*: the counts from the
    report page of the [SilverBullet MCP server](https://github.com/finestream/silverbullet-mcp)'s
    scan, and whether it blocks rendering;
  * *Conflicts*: pages with conflict markers and `.conflicted` copies;
  * *Aspiring pages*: links to pages that do not exist;
  * *Invalid frontmatter*: formal pages whose frontmatter fails validation;
  * *Decisions proposed* and *due for review*: decision records (`#dr`);
  * *Tasks overdue* and *without due date*: open tasks of the Kanboard
    library's cache;
  * *Pages waiting for review*: pages in a configured folder (for example
    where agents write) that have been `proposed` for too long.
  * *Open proposals*: change proposals that are open or stale.
* *Detail pages* `health:<check>` lists the pages behind a count, as links.
* *Change proposals* each open proposal is shown the way GitHub shows a diff
  of a Markdown file: *Formatted* (the page as it will look, removed blocks
  struck through on red, added ones on green; a list or a table keeps its
  shape and only the changed items or rows are coloured) or *Text* (the source
  lines, with the changed words highlighted). *Apply* writes the change to the
  page with your rights, *Edit* opens the proposal so you can change the
  proposed text first, *Reject* drops it, and *Apply all* applies every open
  proposal after one confirmation.
* *Safe output* text from the space (page and tag names, frontmatter values,
  error messages) is never written into the page as is: a page name becomes a
  link only when it cannot break out of one or start like a URL
  (`javascript:`), everything else is shown in a code span, where SilverBullet
  evaluates no directive and renders no HTML.

## Formal and informal pages

A page is *formal* when one of its tags is defined with `tag.define` and a
`schema` or a `validate` function (the ITAM library defines such tags);
every other page is *informal*, with free frontmatter, and is never counted by
*Invalid frontmatter*. Each such tag is checked as the editor's lint does:
`jsonschema.validateObject` with the schema, then `validate`. A tag defined
with `mustValidate = true` keeps a failing page out of the index altogether,
so this check cannot see such a page.

## Where each check reads its data

* *MCP scan*: the headings `Findings (N)` and `Files that are not pages (N)`
  and the list item `Rendering: …` of the report page (`mcpPage`), read from
  the index. Without that page both rows say *no report*.
* *Conflicts*: page and file names containing `.conflicted`, and the text of
  every page that is not excluded, for a line starting with `<<<<<<<`
  followed by `=======` and `>>>>>>>`. SilverBullet indexes only the name of
  a page with conflict markers, so the text has to be read.
* *Decisions*: pages tagged `dr`. *Proposed* means `status: proposed`. *Due
  for review* uses the ITAM library's rule and setting (an active status, and
  `lastReviewed` missing or older than its `reviewDays`); without ITAM the row
  is not shown.
* *Tasks*: tasks with a `kbId` (the Kanboard library's cache) that are not
  done; *overdue* means a due date before today, *without due date*
  `dueRaw == 0`.
* *Pages waiting for review*: pages under `proposedPrefix` with
  `status: proposed` whose frontmatter `date` (or, without one, the last
  change) is more than `proposedDays` days ago. Without `proposedPrefix` the
  row is not shown.
* *Open proposals*: pages tagged `proposal` whose `outcome` is `open`,
  missing or `stale`.

## Configuration

Configuration is optional; without it every view works, and only the check
*Pages waiting for review* is not shown. To change the defaults, add the
following section to your `CONFIG` page in a space-lua block:

```lua
config.set {
  utilities = {
    exclude = { "Library/" },   -- pages left out of every view (default)
    mcpPage = "MCP Server",     -- report page of the MCP server's scan (default)
    proposedPrefix = "Drafts/", -- folder of pages waiting for review (no default)
    proposedDays = 7,           -- days a page may wait in `proposed` (default)
  }
}
```

`exclude` applies to the tag cloud (tags that occur only on excluded pages),
to the pages that link to aspiring pages, and to every other check.

## Usage

### Tag cloud

```
${utilities.tagCloud()}
```

Tags starting with `meta` are left out, as are tag names that hold a
character that could break the link (`[ ] | { } $ < >` or a backtick) or
that starts like a URL scheme (`name:`).

### Health

```
${utilities.health()}
```

The *Detail* column links to the check's detail page, for example
`[[health:aspiring]]`; the MCP rows link to the report page.

### Proposals

```
${utilities.proposals()}
${utilities.proposals("Some/Page")}
```

The first lists every open proposal, the second only those for one page (put
it on that page to see what is waiting for it).

A proposal is a page tagged `proposal`. Its frontmatter names the page to
change, and its body holds the reason as text and then one pair of fenced
blocks per change: the text as it is now, and the text that replaces it.
Use four tildes, so the blocks can contain backticks and code fences.

```markdown
---
tags: proposal
target: "[[Notes/Garden]]"
outcome: open
---
Watering moved to the morning.

~~~~expected
Watering is done in the evening.
~~~~
~~~~replacement
Watering is done early in the morning.
~~~~
```

* **Stale check.** Every expected text must occur exactly once in the target
  page, when the proposal is shown and again when it is applied. Otherwise the
  proposal cannot be applied, and shows why; *Close as stale* records that.
  Nothing is matched approximately: the author writes a new proposal.
* **Outcome.** *Apply*, *Reject* and *Close as stale* record `applied`,
  `rejected` or `stale` in the proposal's `outcome`; only `open` (or no
  `outcome`) and `stale` proposals are listed. Proposal pages are never
  deleted by the library.
* **Nothing runs before you apply.** The formatted view is rendered by
  SilverBullet's own Markdown renderer, which shows `${...}` as text and drops
  scripts and event handlers; the text view is plain text. The proposed text
  runs only once it is in the page, like anything you write yourself.
* **The diff** is computed by [jsdiff](https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff)
  (BSD-3-Clause), which is part of the library: nothing is loaded from the
  network.

## Code

```space-lua
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Package utilities
--
-- Space-wide views that belong to no other library: the tag cloud and
-- the health table (health.lua). Pages call utilities.tagCloud() and
-- utilities.health() only.
--
-- Everything is computed from the index when a page is shown; nothing
-- is stored. Text that comes from the space (page names, tag names,
-- frontmatter values, error messages) is never written into markdown
-- as is: page names become links only when they cannot break out of
-- one, everything else goes into a code span (utilities.code).
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
utilities = utilities or {}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.defaults
--
-- Fallback values for the "utilities" section of the CONFIG page.
-- proposedPrefix has no default: the check it drives is shown only
-- once a folder is configured.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
utilities.defaults = {
	exclude = { "Library/" },  -- pages left out of every view
	mcpPage = "MCP Server",    -- report page of the MCP server's scan
	proposedPrefix = nil,      -- folder of pages waiting for review; nil: no check
	proposedDays = 7           -- days a page may wait in `proposed`
}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.config()
--
-- Reads the "utilities" section of the CONFIG page.
--
-- Returns:
--   Table with the configured values, and the defaults for every key
--   the user did not configure.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.config()
	local effective = {}
	for key, value in pairs(utilities.defaults) do effective[key] = value end
	for key, value in pairs(config.get("utilities", {}) or {}) do effective[key] = value end
	return effective
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.excluded(name)
--
-- Whether a page (or document) name starts with one of the configured
-- `exclude` prefixes.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.excluded(name)
	for _, prefix in ipairs(utilities.config().exclude or {}) do
		if string.startsWith(name, prefix) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.safeName(name)
--
-- Whether a name can be written into a wiki link or a tag link as is:
-- no brackets, pipes, braces, dollars, angle brackets, backticks or
-- line breaks, which could end the link or start a directive or HTML,
-- and no leading URL scheme ("javascript:"), which could turn the link
-- into something other than a page.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.safeName(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return false end
	if string.find(name, "^%a[%w+-]*:") then return false end
	return string.find(name, "[%[%]|{}%$<>`\r\n]") == nil
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.code(text)
--
-- Any value as an inert markdown code span, fit for a table cell.
--
-- The fence is one backtick longer than the longest run of backticks
-- in the text, line breaks become spaces and pipes are escaped, so
-- the text can neither end the span nor the table cell. Inside a code
-- span SilverBullet evaluates no directive and renders no HTML.
--
-- Returns:
--   The code span, or "" for nil and the empty string.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.code(text)
	if text == nil then return "" end
	local flat = string.gsub(tostring(text), "[\r\n]+", " ")
	if flat == "" then return "" end
	local longest = 0
	for run in string.gmatch(flat, "`+") do
		if #run > longest then longest = #run end
	end
	local fence = string.rep("`", longest + 1)
	local escaped = string.gsub(flat, "|", "\\|")
	return fence .. " " .. escaped .. " " .. fence
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.link(name)
--
-- A page name as a wiki link when that is safe, as a code span
-- otherwise.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.link(name)
	if utilities.safeName(name) then return "[[" .. name .. "]]" end
	return utilities.code(name)
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.table(columns, rows)
--
-- A markdown table. Cells must already be markdown (utilities.code,
-- utilities.link or numbers).
--
-- Returns:
--   The table, or "*None.*" when there are no rows.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.table(columns, rows)
	if #rows == 0 then return "*None.*" end
	local lines = {
		"| " .. table.concat(columns, " | ") .. " |",
		"|" .. string.rep(" --- |", #columns)
	}
	for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
		local cells = {}
		for i = 1, #columns do
			local value = row[i]
			if value == nil then value = "" end
			table.insert(cells, tostring(value))
		end
		table.insert(lines, "| " .. table.concat(cells, " | ") .. " |")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.today()
--
-- Today's date as "YYYY-MM-DD", for comparing with frontmatter dates.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.today()
	return os.date("%Y-%m-%d")
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.daysAgo(days)
--
-- The date `days` days before today as "YYYY-MM-DD".
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.daysAgo(days)
	return os.date("%Y-%m-%d", os.time() - days * 86400)
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.day(value)
--
-- The "YYYY-MM-DD" part of a date or timestamp value, or nil.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.day(value)
	if value == nil then return nil end
	return string.match(tostring(value), "^(%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d)")
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.tagCloud()
--
-- Every tag of the space once, alphabetically, as tag links
-- ([[tag:x|#x]]) separated by spaces, for inline use on a page:
-- ${utilities.tagCloud()}.
--
-- Left out: tags starting with "meta", tags that occur only on pages
-- matching the `exclude` prefixes, and tags whose name could break the
-- link (utilities.safeName).
--
-- Returns:
--   The links as one markdown string ("" when there is no tag).
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.tagCloud()
	local seen, out = {}, {}
	local tags = query[[from t = index.tag "tag" order by t.name]]
	for _, t in ipairs(tags) do
		if not seen[t.name]
			and not string.startsWith(t.name, "meta")
			and not utilities.excluded(t.page)
			and utilities.safeName(t.name) then
			seen[t.name] = true
			table.insert(out, "[[tag:" .. t.name .. "|#" .. t.name .. "]]")
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out, " ")
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.jsdiffSource
--
-- jsdiff 9.0.0 (https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff), BSD-3-Clause,
-- Copyright (c) 2009-2015, Kevin Decker; licence in
-- src/utilities/vendor/jsdiff-LICENSE of the repository. Its ES module
-- bundle, minified with esbuild, base64-encoded: SilverBullet's Lua
-- cannot hold the minified code in a long string. Imported from a
-- data: URL by utilities.jsdiff(). Generated by `make vendor-utilities`.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
utilities.jsdiffSource = ""

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Package utilities (proposals)
--
-- A proposal is a page, typically written by an agent that may not
-- write the target page itself: tag `proposal`, frontmatter `target`
-- (a page link) and `outcome`, then pairs of fenced blocks
-- ~~~~expected / ~~~~replacement. ${utilities.proposals()} lists the
-- open proposals, each showing its change the way GitHub shows a diff
-- of a Markdown file (formatted, or as text), with Apply, Edit and
-- Reject; the person who clicks Apply writes the target page with
-- their own rights.
--
-- Outcomes: open (or none), applied, rejected, stale. Only open and
-- stale proposals are listed.
--
-- The diff is computed by jsdiff (BSD-3-Clause), embedded in
-- jsdiff.lua and imported from a data: URL, so nothing is loaded
-- from the network.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.jsdiff()
--
-- The jsdiff module, imported once.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.jsdiff()
	if not utilities.jsdiffModule then
		utilities.jsdiffModule = js.import("data:text/javascript;base64," .. utilities.jsdiffSource)
	end
	return utilities.jsdiffModule
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.unlink(value)
--
-- "[[Some/Page]]" -> "Some/Page"
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.unlink(value)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
	return string.match(value, "^%[%[(.-)%]%]$") or value
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.readProposal(name)
--
-- Reads a proposal page.
--
-- Returns:
--   Table { name, target, outcome, changes = { {expected, replacement} } },
--   or nil and an error message.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.readProposal(name)
	local page = (query[[from p = index.pages() where p.name == name]])[1]
	if not page then return nil, "no such page" end
	local target = utilities.unlink(page.target)
	if not target then return nil, "no target in the frontmatter" end
	local text = "\n" .. space.readPage(name)
	local blocks = {}
	for kind, body in string.gmatch(text, "\n~~~~(%a+)\n(.-)\n~~~~") do
		table.insert(blocks, { kind = kind, body = body })
	end
	local changes = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #blocks do
		if blocks[i].kind == "expected" and blocks[i + 1] and blocks[i + 1].kind == "replacement" then
			table.insert(changes, { expected = blocks[i].body, replacement = blocks[i + 1].body })
			i = i + 2
		else
			return nil, "block " .. i .. " is not an expected/replacement pair"
		end
	end
	if #changes == 0 then return nil, "no changes" end
	return { name = name, target = target, outcome = page.outcome or "open", changes = changes }
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.applyChanges(text, changes)
--
-- The text after the changes. Every expected text must occur exactly
-- once (the stale check).
--
-- Returns:
--   The new text, or nil and an error message.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.applyChanges(text, changes)
	for n, change in ipairs(changes) do
		local first = string.find(text, change.expected, 1, true)
		if not first then return nil, "change " .. n .. ": the expected text is not in the page" end
		if string.find(text, change.expected, first + 1, true) then
			return nil, "change " .. n .. ": the expected text occurs more than once"
		end
		local before = string.sub(text, 1, first - 1)
		local after = string.sub(text, first + #change.expected)
		text = before .. change.replacement .. after
	end
	return text
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.lines(value)
--
-- The lines of a diff part, without the final line break.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.lines(value)
	local out = {}
	local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "\n$", "")
	for line in string.gmatch(trimmed .. "\n", "(.-)\n") do table.insert(out, line) end
	return out
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.el(tag, attributes, text)
--
-- A DOM element with `text` as a plain text node. String children of
-- the dom API are rendered as markdown, which would turn "# x" into a
-- heading and [[x]] into a link, so text from a page never goes in as
-- a string child.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.el(tag, attributes, text)
	local element = dom[tag](attributes or {})
	if text ~= nil then
		element.appendChild(js.window.document.createTextNode(tostring(text)))
	end
	return element
end

-- Colours that read on light and dark themes alike.
utilities.diffColours = {
	removedLine = "rgba(255,129,130,0.15)",
	removedWord = "rgba(255,129,130,0.45)",
	addedLine = "rgba(46,160,67,0.15)",
	addedWord = "rgba(46,160,67,0.45)",
	removedBar = "rgb(207,34,46)",
	addedBar = "rgb(26,127,55)"
}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.codeLine(segments, colour)
--
-- One line of the text diff as a DOM node: segments are { text,
-- highlighted } pairs, highlighted ones get the word colour.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.codeLine(segments, colour)
	local cell = dom.td { style = "white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;padding:0 0.5em;font-family:var(--editor-font, monospace);" }
	for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
		if s[2] then
			cell.appendChild(utilities.el("span", { style = "background:" .. colour .. ";border-radius:2px;" }, s[1]))
		else
			cell.appendChild(utilities.el("span", {}, s[1]))
		end
	end
	return cell
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.textDiff(old, new)
--
-- The text view: changed lines with three lines of context, removed
-- in red, added in green, changed words highlighted when a block of
-- removed lines is followed by as many added ones.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.textDiff(old, new)
	local m = utilities.jsdiff()
	local c = utilities.diffColours
	local parts = m.diffLines(old, new)
	-- flatten into rows { kind, oldNo, newNo, segments }
	local rows = {}
	local oldNo, newNo = 1, 1
	local i = 1
	while i <= parts.length do
		local p = parts[i]
		local nextPart = (i < parts.length) and parts[i + 1] or nil
		if p.removed and nextPart and nextPart.added and #utilities.lines(p.value) == #utilities.lines(nextPart.value) then
			local removedLines, addedLines = utilities.lines(p.value), utilities.lines(nextPart.value)
			local pendingAdded = {}
			for k = 1, #removedLines do
				local words = m.diffWordsWithSpace(removedLines[k], addedLines[k])
				local minus, plus = {}, {}
				for w = 1, words.length do
					local word = words[w]
					if word.removed then table.insert(minus, { word.value, true })
					elseif word.added then table.insert(plus, { word.value, true })
					else
						table.insert(minus, { word.value, false })
						table.insert(plus, { word.value, false })
					end
				end
				table.insert(rows, { kind = "-", oldNo = oldNo, segments = minus })
				oldNo = oldNo + 1
				table.insert(pendingAdded, plus)
			end
			for _, plus in ipairs(pendingAdded) do
				table.insert(rows, { kind = "+", newNo = newNo, segments = plus })
				newNo = newNo + 1
			end
			i = i + 2
		else
			for _, line in ipairs(utilities.lines(p.value)) do
				if p.removed then
					table.insert(rows, { kind = "-", oldNo = oldNo, segments = { { line, false } } })
					oldNo = oldNo + 1
				elseif p.added then
					table.insert(rows, { kind = "+", newNo = newNo, segments = { { line, false } } })
					newNo = newNo + 1
				else
					table.insert(rows, { kind = " ", oldNo = oldNo, newNo = newNo, segments = { { line, false } } })
					oldNo, newNo = oldNo + 1, newNo + 1
				end
			end
			i = i + 1
		end
	end
	-- keep three lines of context around every change
	local keep = {}
	for n, row in ipairs(rows) do
		if row.kind ~= " " then
			for k = math.max(1, n - 3), math.min(#rows, n + 3) do keep[k] = true end
		end
	end
	local tbl = dom.table { style = "border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:0.85em;" }
	local skipped = 0
	local function flushSkipped()
		if skipped > 0 then
			local tr = dom.tr {}
			tr.appendChild(utilities.el("td", { colspan = "4", style = "opacity:0.6;padding:0.2em 0.5em;font-style:italic;" },
				skipped .. " unchanged line" .. (skipped == 1 and "" or "s")))
			tbl.appendChild(tr)
			skipped = 0
		end
	end
	for n, row in ipairs(rows) do
		if keep[n] then
			flushSkipped()
			local bg, word = "transparent", nil
			if row.kind == "-" then bg, word = c.removedLine, c.removedWord end
			if row.kind == "+" then bg, word = c.addedLine, c.addedWord end
			local num = "opacity:0.5;text-align:right;padding:0 0.4em;user-select:none;font-family:monospace;"
			local tr = dom.tr { style = "background:" .. bg .. ";" }
			tr.appendChild(utilities.el("td", { style = num }, row.oldNo or ""))
			tr.appendChild(utilities.el("td", { style = num }, row.newNo or ""))
			tr.appendChild(utilities.el("td", { style = "user-select:none;font-family:monospace;padding:0 0.2em;" }, row.kind))
			tr.appendChild(utilities.codeLine(row.segments, word or bg))
			tbl.appendChild(tr)
		else
			skipped = skipped + 1
		end
	end
	flushSkipped()
	return tbl
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.stripFrontmatter(text)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.stripFrontmatter(text)
	local body = string.match(text, "^%-%-%-\n.-\n%-%-%-\n(.*)$")
	return body or text
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.formattedDiff(old, new)
--
-- The formatted view: the page as it will look, rendered by
-- SilverBullet's own markdown renderer (which shows ${...} as text
-- and drops scripts and event handlers); removed blocks struck
-- through on red, added blocks on green.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.formattedDiff(old, new)
	local m = utilities.jsdiff()
	local c = utilities.diffColours
	local container = dom.div { style = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.3em;" }

	local function render(text, kind)
		local style = "padding:0.1em 0.6em;"
		if kind == "-" then
			style = style .. "background:" .. c.removedLine .. ";border-left:3px solid " .. c.removedBar .. ";text-decoration:line-through;opacity:0.85;"
		elseif kind == "+" then
			style = style .. "background:" .. c.addedLine .. ";border-left:3px solid " .. c.addedBar .. ";"
		else
			style = style .. "border-left:3px solid transparent;"
		end
		local block = dom.div { style = style }
		block.innerHTML = markdown.markdownToHtml(text)
		container.appendChild(block)
	end

	local function blocks(text)
		local out = {}
		for block in string.gmatch(utilities.stripFrontmatter(text) .. "\n\n", "(.-)\n[ \t]*\n") do
			if string.find(block, "%S") then table.insert(out, block) end
		end
		return out
	end

	local function isList(block)
		for _, line in ipairs(utilities.lines(block)) do
			if not (string.find(line, "^%s*[%*%-%+] ") or string.find(line, "^%s*%d+%. ")) then return false end
		end
		return true
	end

	-- a changed list: item by item, so an added item does not repeat the list
	local function listDiff(before, after)
		local items = m.diffArrays(js.tojs(utilities.lines(before)), js.tojs(utilities.lines(after)))
		for i = 1, items.length do
			local part = items[i]
			local kind = part.removed and "-" or (part.added and "+" or " ")
			local lines = {}
			for k = 1, part.value.length do table.insert(lines, part.value[k]) end
			render(table.concat(lines, "\n"), kind)
		end
	end

	local function isTable(block)
		local lines = utilities.lines(block)
		if #lines < 2 then return false end
		for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
			if not string.find(line, "^%s*|") then return false end
		end
		return true
	end

	-- a changed table: one table holding the removed and the added rows,
	-- each row coloured, so the table keeps its shape
	local function tableDiff(before, after)
		local oldLines, newLines = utilities.lines(before), utilities.lines(after)
		local oldRows, newRows = {}, {}
		for k = 3, #oldLines do table.insert(oldRows, oldLines[k]) end
		for k = 3, #newLines do table.insert(newRows, newLines[k]) end
		local rows = m.diffArrays(js.tojs(oldRows), js.tojs(newRows))
		local lines, kinds = { newLines[1], newLines[2] }, {}
		for i = 1, rows.length do
			local part = rows[i]
			for k = 1, part.value.length do
				table.insert(lines, part.value[k])
				table.insert(kinds, part.removed and "-" or (part.added and "+" or " "))
			end
		end
		local block = dom.div { style = "padding:0.1em 0.6em;border-left:3px solid " .. c.addedBar .. ";" }
		block.innerHTML = markdown.markdownToHtml(table.concat(lines, "\n"))
		local trs = block.querySelectorAll("tr")
		for k, kind in ipairs(kinds) do
			local tr = trs[k + 1]
			if tr and kind == "-" then
				tr.style.background = c.removedWord
				tr.style.textDecoration = "line-through"
			elseif tr and kind == "+" then
				tr.style.background = c.addedWord
			end
		end
		container.appendChild(block)
	end

	local parts = m.diffArrays(js.tojs(blocks(old)), js.tojs(blocks(new)))
	local i = 1
	while i <= parts.length do
		local p = parts[i]
		local nextPart = (i < parts.length) and parts[i + 1] or nil
		if p.removed and nextPart and nextPart.added and p.value.length == nextPart.value.length then
			for k = 1, p.value.length do
				local before, after = p.value[k], nextPart.value[k]
				if isList(before) and isList(after) then
					listDiff(before, after)
				elseif isTable(before) and isTable(after) then
					tableDiff(before, after)
				else
					render(before, "-")
					render(after, "+")
				end
			end
			i = i + 2
		else
			local kind = p.removed and "-" or (p.added and "+" or " ")
			for k = 1, p.value.length do render(p.value[k], kind) end
			i = i + 1
		end
	end
	return container
end


-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.setOutcome(name, outcome)
--
-- Records the outcome in the frontmatter of a proposal page: replaces
-- its `outcome:` line, or adds one before the closing "---".
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.setOutcome(name, outcome)
	local text = space.readPage(name)
	local frontmatter, rest = string.match(text, "^(%-%-%-\n.-\n)(%-%-%-\n.*)$")
	if not frontmatter then
		text = "---\noutcome: " .. outcome .. "\n---\n" .. text
	elseif string.find(frontmatter, "\noutcome:") or string.find(frontmatter, "^%-%-%-\noutcome:") then
		local replaced = string.gsub(frontmatter, "\noutcome:[^\n]*", "\noutcome: " .. outcome, 1)
		text = replaced .. rest
	else
		text = frontmatter .. "outcome: " .. outcome .. "\n" .. rest
	end
	space.writePage(name, text)
	utilities.recentOutcomes[name] = outcome
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.recentOutcomes
--
-- Outcomes just written, by proposal name. The index learns about the
-- write a moment later; until it has, the list uses these, so a
-- proposal disappears as soon as it is applied or rejected.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
utilities.recentOutcomes = utilities.recentOutcomes or {}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.applyProposal(name)
--
-- Applies a proposal: reads it and its target again, runs the stale
-- check, writes the target page and records `applied`. A stale
-- proposal is recorded as `stale` and the target is not touched.
--
-- Returns:
--   true, or false and the reason.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.applyProposal(name)
	local proposal, err = utilities.readProposal(name)
	if not proposal then return false, err end
	local ok, old = pcall(space.readPage, proposal.target)
	if not ok then return false, "the target page cannot be read" end
	local new, stale = utilities.applyChanges(old, proposal.changes)
	if not new then
		utilities.setOutcome(name, "stale")
		return false, "stale: " .. stale
	end
	space.writePage(proposal.target, new)
	utilities.setOutcome(name, "applied")
	return true
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.openProposals(target)
--
-- The names of the proposals that are open or stale, optionally only
-- those for one target page, by name.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.openProposals(target)
	local names = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.tag "proposal" where p.tag == "page" order by p.name]]) do
		local outcome = p.outcome or "open"
		local recent = utilities.recentOutcomes[p.name]
		if recent == outcome then
			utilities.recentOutcomes[p.name] = nil
		elseif recent then
			outcome = recent
		end
		if not utilities.excluded(p.name)
			and (outcome == "open" or outcome == "stale")
			and (target == nil or utilities.unlink(p.target) == target) then
			table.insert(names, p.name)
		end
	end
	return names
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.refresh()
--
-- Re-renders the widgets of the page shown, after an action changed
-- what they display.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.refresh()
	if codeWidget and codeWidget.refreshAll then codeWidget.refreshAll() end
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.proposalView(name)
--
-- The review view of one proposal as a DOM node: the target and the
-- reason, a switch between the formatted and the text diff (formatted
-- first), and Apply / Edit / Reject. A stale proposal shows why, and
-- Close records it as stale.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.proposalView(name)
	local c = utilities.diffColours
	local container = dom.div { class = "utilities-proposal", style = "border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.4);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;" }
	local header = dom.div { style = "display:flex;gap:0.5em;align-items:center;padding:0.4em 5em 0.4em 0.6em;background:rgba(128,128,128,0.12);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.4);flex-wrap:wrap;" }
	container.appendChild(header)
	local proposal, err = utilities.readProposal(name)
	local old, new, stale
	if proposal then
		local ok, text = pcall(space.readPage, proposal.target)
		if ok then
			old = text
			new, stale = utilities.applyChanges(old, proposal.changes)
		else
			stale = "the target page " .. proposal.target .. " cannot be read"
		end
	else
		stale = err
	end
	local title = utilities.el("a", { style = "font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;", onclick = function() editor.navigate(name) end }, name)
	header.appendChild(title)
	if proposal then
		header.appendChild(utilities.el("span", { style = "opacity:0.7;" }, "→ " .. proposal.target .. " · " .. #proposal.changes .. " change" .. (#proposal.changes == 1 and "" or "s") .. " · " .. proposal.outcome))
	end
	header.appendChild(dom.span { style = "flex:1;" })

	local function act(action)
		local ok, why = action()
		if ok then
			utilities.refresh()
		else
			editor.flashNotification(name .. ": " .. tostring(why), "error")
			utilities.refresh()
		end
	end

	if not new then
		container.appendChild(utilities.el("div", { style = "padding:0.6em;background:" .. c.removedLine .. ";" }, "Cannot be applied: " .. tostring(stale)))
		header.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function() editor.navigate(name) end }, "Edit"))
		if proposal then
			header.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function()
				act(function() utilities.setOutcome(name, "stale"); return true end)
			end }, "Close as stale"))
		end
		return container
	end

	local body = dom.div { style = "padding:0.4em 0;" }
	local formattedView = utilities.formattedDiff(old, new)
	local textView = utilities.textDiff(old, new)
	textView.style.display = "none"
	local formattedButton, textButton
	local function show(which)
		formattedView.style.display = (which == "formatted") and "flex" or "none"
		textView.style.display = (which == "text") and "" or "none"
		formattedButton.style.fontWeight = (which == "formatted") and "bold" or "normal"
		textButton.style.fontWeight = (which == "text") and "bold" or "normal"
	end
	formattedButton = utilities.el("button", { onclick = function() show("formatted") end }, "Formatted")
	textButton = utilities.el("button", { onclick = function() show("text") end }, "Text")
	header.appendChild(formattedButton)
	header.appendChild(textButton)
	header.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function()
		act(function() return utilities.applyProposal(name) end)
	end }, "Apply"))
	header.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function() editor.navigate(name) end }, "Edit"))
	header.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function()
		act(function() utilities.setOutcome(name, "rejected"); return true end)
	end }, "Reject"))
	formattedButton.style.fontWeight = "bold"
	body.appendChild(formattedView)
	body.appendChild(textView)
	container.appendChild(body)
	return container
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.proposals(target)
--
-- The review page: ${utilities.proposals()} lists every open proposal,
-- ${utilities.proposals("Some/Page")} only those for that page. Each
-- is shown with its diff and buttons; "Apply all" applies every
-- proposal that is not stale, after a confirmation that names the
-- target pages.
--
-- Returns:
--   A block widget.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.proposals(target)
	local names = utilities.openProposals(target)
	if #names == 0 then
		return widget.markdownBlock("*No open proposals.*")
	end
	local container = dom.div { style = "display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1em;" }
	local bar = dom.div { style = "display:flex;gap:0.5em;align-items:center;padding-right:5em;" }
	bar.appendChild(utilities.el("span", { style = "opacity:0.7;" }, #names .. " open proposal" .. (#names == 1 and "" or "s")))
	bar.appendChild(utilities.el("button", { onclick = function()
		local targets, seen = {}, {}
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			local proposal = utilities.readProposal(name)
			if proposal and not seen[proposal.target] then
				seen[proposal.target] = true
				table.insert(targets, proposal.target)
			end
		end
		if not editor.confirm("Apply " .. #names .. " proposal(s) to: " .. table.concat(targets, ", ") .. "?") then return end
		local applied, failed = 0, {}
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			local ok, why = utilities.applyProposal(name)
			if ok then applied = applied + 1 else table.insert(failed, name .. " (" .. tostring(why) .. ")") end
		end
		local message = applied .. " applied"
		if #failed > 0 then message = message .. "; not applied: " .. table.concat(failed, "; ") end
		editor.flashNotification(message, #failed > 0 and "error" or "info")
		utilities.refresh()
	end }, "Apply all"))
	container.appendChild(bar)
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		container.appendChild(utilities.proposalView(name))
	end
	return widget.new { html = container, display = "block" }
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Package utilities (health)
--
-- The health table of the space: ${utilities.health()} shows one row
-- per check with a count and a link to the check's detail, the
-- virtual page health:<key>.
--
-- A check either lists rows (pages, tasks, ...), which are its detail
-- and whose number is its count, or reads a count from the report page
-- of the MCP server's scan. Both the table and the detail pages call
-- the same functions, so they cannot disagree.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.mcpReport()
--
-- Reads the report page of the MCP server's scan from the index: the
-- counts in the headings "Findings (N)" and "Files that are not pages
-- (N)", and whether the list item "Rendering: ..." says it is blocked.
--
-- Returns:
--   Table { findings, files, blocked }, or nil when the page has no
--   such headings (not installed, not indexed yet).
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.mcpReport()
	local name = utilities.config().mcpPage
	local report = { blocked = false }
	local headers = query[[from h = index.tag "header" where h.page == name]]
	for _, h in ipairs(headers) do
		local findings = string.match(h.name, "^Findings %((%d+)%)")
		if findings then report.findings = tonumber(findings) end
		local files = string.match(h.name, "^Files that are not pages %((%d+)%)")
		if files then report.files = tonumber(files) end
	end
	if report.findings == nil and report.files == nil then return nil end
	local items = query[[from i = index.tag "item" where i.page == name]]
	for _, i in ipairs(items) do
		if i.text and string.startsWith(i.text, "Rendering:") and string.find(i.text, "blocked", 1, true) then
			report.blocked = true
		end
	end
	return report
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.hasConflictMarkers(text)
--
-- Whether a page text holds a conflict: a line starting with
-- "<<<<<<<", a later "=======" and a later ">>>>>>>". This is what
-- SilverBullet writes when two edits cannot be merged.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.hasConflictMarkers(text)
	local padded = "\n" .. text
	local start = string.find(padded, "\n<<<<<<<", 1, true)
	if not start then return false end
	local separator = string.find(padded, "\n=======", start, true)
	if not separator then return false end
	return string.find(padded, "\n>>>>>>>", separator, true) ~= nil
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.conflicts()
--
-- Pages and files in conflict: copies whose name holds ".conflicted"
-- (written by older versions of SilverBullet, and by 2.12 for files it
-- cannot merge), and pages holding conflict markers. A page with
-- markers keeps only its name in the index, so this reads every page
-- that is not excluded.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { page, kind }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.conflicts()
	local rows = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.pages() order by p.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(p.name) then
			if string.find(p.name, ".conflicted", 1, true) then
				table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), "copy" })
			elseif utilities.hasConflictMarkers(space.readPage(p.name)) then
				table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), "conflict markers" })
			end
		end
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(query[[from d = index.documents() order by d.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(d.name) and string.find(d.name, ".conflicted", 1, true) then
			table.insert(rows, { utilities.code(d.name), "copy" })
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.aspiring()
--
-- Links to pages that do not exist, from pages that are not excluded.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { missing page, linked from }, one per missing page.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.aspiring()
	local from, names = {}, {}
	for _, a in ipairs(query[[from a = index.aspiringPages() order by a.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(a.page) then
			if not from[a.name] then
				from[a.name] = {}
				table.insert(names, a.name)
			end
			from[a.name][a.page] = true
		end
	end
	local rows = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		local pages = {}
		for page in pairs(from[name]) do table.insert(pages, page) end
		table.sort(pages)
		local links = {}
		for _, page in ipairs(pages) do table.insert(links, utilities.link(page)) end
		table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(name), table.concat(links, ", ") })
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.invalidFrontmatter()
--
-- Formal pages whose frontmatter fails validation. A page is formal
-- when one of its tags is defined (tag.define) with a `schema` or a
-- `validate` function; every other page is informal and never
-- counted. Each such tag is checked as SilverBullet's editor does:
-- jsonschema.validateObject with the schema, then `validate`.
--
-- A tag defined with mustValidate = true keeps a failing page out of
-- the index altogether, so such pages cannot be seen here.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { page, tag, error }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.invalidFrontmatter()
	local definitions = config.get("tags", {}) or {}
	local rows = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.pages() order by p.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(p.name) then
			for _, t in ipairs(p.tags or {}) do
				local definition = definitions[t]
				if definition and (definition.schema or definition.validate) then
					local err
					if definition.schema then
						err = jsonschema.validateObject(definition.schema, p)
					end
					if not err and definition.validate then
						local ok, result = pcall(definition.validate, p)
						if not ok then
							err = "validate failed: " .. tostring(result)
						else
							err = result
						end
					end
					if err then
						table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), utilities.code("#" .. t), utilities.code(err) })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.decisionsProposed()
--
-- Decision records (pages tagged `dr`) in status `proposed`, waiting
-- for a person to decide.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { decision, id, date }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.decisionsProposed()
	local rows = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.tag "dr" where p.tag == "page" order by p.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(p.name) and p.status == "proposed" then
			table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), utilities.code(p.id), utilities.code(p.date) })
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.decisionsDue()
--
-- Decision records due for review, by the ITAM library's rule and
-- setting: an active status (ITAM.drActive) and `lastReviewed`
-- missing or older than the configured reviewDays. Without ITAM there
-- is no such rule, and the check is not shown.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { decision, id, last reviewed }, or nil without ITAM.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.decisionsDue()
	if not (ITAM and ITAM.config and ITAM.drActive) then return nil end
	local limit = utilities.daysAgo(ITAM.config().dr.reviewDays)
	local rows = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.tag "dr" where p.tag == "page" order by p.name]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(p.name) and ITAM.drActive[p.status] then
			local reviewed = utilities.day(p.lastReviewed)
			if reviewed == nil or reviewed < limit then
				table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), utilities.code(p.id), utilities.code(p.lastReviewed) })
			end
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.openKanboardTasks()
--
-- The open tasks of the Kanboard library's cache (those with a kbId),
-- on pages that are not excluded.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.openKanboardTasks()
	local tasks = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(query[[from t = index.tasks() where t.kbId and not t.done order by t.dueRaw]]) do
		if not utilities.excluded(t.page) then table.insert(tasks, t) end
	end
	return tasks
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.tasksOverdue()
--
-- Open Kanboard tasks whose due date is before today.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { task, due, page }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.tasksOverdue()
	local today = utilities.today()
	local rows = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(utilities.openKanboardTasks()) do
		local due = tonumber(t.dueRaw) or 0
		if due > 0 and os.date("%Y-%m-%d", due) < today then
			table.insert(rows, { utilities.code(t.name), os.date("%Y-%m-%d", due), utilities.link(t.page) })
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.tasksWithoutDue()
--
-- Open Kanboard tasks without a due date.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { task, column, page }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.tasksWithoutDue()
	local rows = {}
	for _, t in ipairs(utilities.openKanboardTasks()) do
		if (tonumber(t.dueRaw) or 0) == 0 then
			table.insert(rows, { utilities.code(t.name), utilities.code(t.column), utilities.link(t.page) })
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.waitingForReview()
--
-- Pages under the configured proposedPrefix (for example the folder
-- where agents write) in status `proposed` for more than proposedDays
-- days, waiting for a person's review. The frontmatter `date` counts;
-- a page without one counts from its last change.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { page, since }, or nil when no proposedPrefix is configured.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.waitingForReview()
	local settings = utilities.config()
	local prefix = settings.proposedPrefix
	if type(prefix) ~= "string" or prefix == "" then return nil end
	local limit = utilities.daysAgo(settings.proposedDays)
	local rows = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(query[[from p = index.pages() where p.status == "proposed" order by p.name]]) do
		if string.startsWith(p.name, prefix) and not utilities.excluded(p.name) then
			local since = utilities.day(p.date) or utilities.day(p.lastModified)
			if since and since < limit then
				table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(p.name), since })
			end
		end
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.proposalRows()
--
-- Proposals that are open or stale (proposals.lua), waiting for a
-- person to apply or reject them.
--
-- Returns:
--   Rows { proposal, target, outcome }.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.proposalRows()
	local rows = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(utilities.openProposals()) do
		local page = (query[[from p = index.pages() where p.name == name]])[1]
		table.insert(rows, { utilities.link(name), utilities.link(utilities.unlink(page and page.target) or ""), utilities.code(page and page.outcome or "open") })
	end
	return rows
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.checks
--
-- The checks of the health table, in order. Each has a title and
-- either
--   detail, columns, rows: a detail page health:<detail>, the
--     column titles and the function listing the rows; rows may
--     return nil, which hides the check
--   report: the field of utilities.mcpReport() that is the count;
--     the detail is the report page itself
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
utilities.checks = {
	{ title = "MCP scan: findings", report = "findings" },
	{ title = "Conflicts", detail = "conflicts", columns = { "Page", "Kind" }, rows = utilities.conflicts },
	{ title = "Aspiring pages", detail = "aspiring", columns = { "Missing page", "Linked from" }, rows = utilities.aspiring },
	{ title = "Invalid frontmatter", detail = "frontmatter", columns = { "Page", "Tag", "Error" }, rows = utilities.invalidFrontmatter },
	{ title = "Decisions proposed", detail = "decisions", columns = { "Decision", "id", "date" }, rows = utilities.decisionsProposed },
	{ title = "Decisions due for review", detail = "decisions", columns = { "Decision", "id", "last reviewed" }, rows = utilities.decisionsDue },
	{ title = "Tasks overdue", detail = "tasks", columns = { "Task", "Due", "Page" }, rows = utilities.tasksOverdue },
	{ title = "Tasks without due date", detail = "tasks", columns = { "Task", "Column", "Page" }, rows = utilities.tasksWithoutDue },
	{ title = "Pages waiting for review", detail = "proposed", columns = { "Page", "Proposed since" }, rows = utilities.waitingForReview },
	{ title = "Open proposals", detail = "proposals", columns = { "Proposal", "Target", "Outcome" }, rows = utilities.proposalRows },
	{ title = "MCP scan: files that are not pages", report = "files" }
}

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.health()
--
-- The health table: ${utilities.health()}.
--
-- One row per check: its title, linking to its detail, and its count.
-- The MCP rows say "no report" when the report page is missing, and
-- the findings row says when rendering is blocked.
--
-- Returns:
--   A markdown block widget.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.health()
	local report = utilities.mcpReport()
	local mcpLink = utilities.link(utilities.config().mcpPage)
	local rows = {}
	for _, check in ipairs(utilities.checks) do
		if check.report then
			local count = "no report"
			if report then
				count = tostring(report[check.report] or "?")
				if check.report == "findings" and report.blocked then
					count = count .. ", rendering blocked"
				end
			end
			table.insert(rows, { check.title, count, mcpLink })
		else
			local found = check.rows()
			if found then
				table.insert(rows, { check.title, tostring(#found), "[[health:" .. check.detail .. "]]" })
			end
		end
	end
	return widget.markdownBlock(utilities.table({ "Check", "Count", "Detail" }, rows))
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- utilities.healthPage(detail)
--
-- The markdown of the virtual page health:<detail>: one section per
-- check with that detail, each a table of its rows.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function utilities.healthPage(detail)
	local parts = {}
	for _, check in ipairs(utilities.checks) do
		if check.detail == detail then
			local found = check.rows()
			if found then
				table.insert(parts, "## " .. check.title .. " (" .. #found .. ")\n\n" .. utilities.table(check.columns, found))
			end
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return "# Health\n\nNo such check: " .. utilities.code(detail) .. "\n"
	end
	return "# Health: " .. detail .. "\n\n" .. table.concat(parts, "\n\n") .. "\n"
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Virtual page: the detail of a health check
--
-- Pattern: health:<detail>, e.g. health:aspiring
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
virtualPage.define {
	pattern = "health:(.+)",
	run = function(detail)
		return utilities.healthPage(detail)
	end
}
```
